text:
Maya: Quick heads up — we’re doing a microlaunch push for the benchmark webinar next Wed. Need X thread + LinkedIn carousel scheduled, seedlist routing for inbound, and 1‑pager asset. Who’s on copy + assets? :rocket:

AJ: I can draft two headline variations. Who’s the primary CTA — sign up or watch on demand?

Maya: Primary CTA = register (live). Secondary CTA = watch recording. Also want a soft benchmarking narrative for follow-ups (cost/latency comparison).

Lucas: Can we do this cadence?
```
- Mon 10:00am (X teaser thread, 4 tweets)
- Tue 2:00pm (LinkedIn carousel #1)
- Wed 8:30am (X reminder thread + single image)
- Wed 30m before (X live start push)
- Thu 11:00am (post-event benchmark highlights)
```

Lucas: I’ll queue scheduling in Buffer once copy is final.

Kelly: Asset ask: 1 hero slide (1200x675), 3 carousel panels (1080x1080), 1 animated GIF (3s loop). Figma link: https://www.figma.com/file/abc123/redwood-webinar-assets

Jamie: I’ll take inbound routing + SDR handoff. Plan: seedlist A = active enterprise trial accounts, B = recent API signups last 90d. Routing: A -> dedicated AE, B -> SDR queue with priority tag `webinar_benchmark`.

AJ: UTM/name convention? propose: campaign=webinar_benchmark_2026, source={x|linkedin}, content={teaser|carousel|reminder}. Thoughts?

Maya: Yes that naming works. AJ — can you include two copy variants: one product-focused, one benchmark-first?

AJ: On it. Will drop both by EOD Fri. :thumbsup:

Kelly: Small ask — can the hero include a 1‑line stat: “2x latency savings in production” (still verifying). If not confirmed, use generic “optimized inference.”

Lucas: Re: platform posting — X thread should be the lead channel. LinkedIn carousel is for longer-form. We’ll stagger times so they don’t overlap.

Maya: Good. Jamie — set up a short playbook for SDRs: 1) quick call script, 2) follow-up email template referencing the benchmark. Jamie: can you share by Mon morning?

Jamie: Yep — will have playbook + Slack snippet for AE/SDR copy.

Kelly: I need final copy + approved stat by Fri 5pm to finish creative.

Lucas: Scheduling note — tagging ChannelBot to reserve the Wed live push slot at 8:30am PT.

ChannelBot: Scheduled — post queued for channel #xlnk at 2487740000.

Maya: Thanks all. After the webinar we’ll pull top 3 quotes and do 1 follow-up post with benchmark nuggets + lead magnet link. Assigning follow-up: Lucas (post), Jamie (lead routing), AJ (copy). :sparkles:

AJ: Quick QA — for X thread length, do we want 4 tweets or shorter 2-tweet tease? My vote = 4 for storytelling.

Kelly: 4 tweets + GIF in tweet 2.

Maya: Consensus = 4. Final checklist: copy variants (AJ), creative (Kelly), schedule (Lucas), SDR playbook (Jamie), seedlist export (Maya). If anyone needs extra time shout here.

Lucas: I’ll drop a prepared Buffer draft once AJ posts content here.

Kelly: Will ping design for GIF today.

Jamie: Adding a short Airtable form for SDRs to mark inbound leads and call outcomes. Link to follow.

Maya: Perfect. Thanks team — moving to action. :white_check_mark:
